notes: The independent second reading preserves all accepted text, formula labels, cancellations, source marks and earlier lexical doubts. Its substantive changes concern literal drawing detail. The upright square has an incomplete one-branch terminal on the left vertical connector. The rotated figures contain omitted heads on sphere A and on sphere C; sphere D has a bottom turning head that the accepted draft placed at the right, and a visibly open infinity loop. On sphere B and the cancelled sphere E, the remaining real branch/return strokes are reproduced without claiming a complete conventional head where overtracing prevents one from being isolated. The small loop beside E's 1 is open at the bottom and retains its distinct right terminal head. The cancelled sphere F retains a separate dash near infinity and three separate exterior strokes, without an inferred connection to its interior diagonal. An independent unlabelled curve between spheres A and B is added beside that parent block in the inventory. Its only new crop clips one extremity; the whole isolated contour was seen in the native bottom half and was independently checked there by the main reader. The mapping table's first and third terminal shapes are drawn literally; all source and target values are unchanged. H's drawing implementations are unavailable. Its generic prose was not treated as a claim about local geometry or as an omission of a complete drawing; H differences are confined to the explicit left-vertical arrow and the explicit mapping glyphs. No new mathematical slip was identified, and no theorem, identity, or topology claim was proved or computed during this audit.
